author: Nicole Brockbank
description: So-called "Crypto King" Aiden Pleterski sounded "cool and collected" in a secret audio recording taken by his alleged kidnappers, according to one of their defence lawyers, who suggested the recording was made as an "insurance policy" to show the kidnapping was a hoax.
title: Secret audio captures 'Crypto King' planning his own kidnapping, defence lawyer says

author: Sheena Goodyear
description: Despite its "sexy name," the newly identified Vampyrocamelus was no blood-sucking fiend.
title: Behold the vampire camel, the fanged beast that once roamed North America

author: Shaurya Kshatri
description: A B.C.-based restaurant group that operates Moxie's, Chop Steakhouse and Shark Club is suing six current and former executives and directors of a digital payment company over more than $2.1 million in funds allegedly owed to the group.
title: B.C. restaurant group alleges $2.1M in missing staff tips, sues payment company executives

description: Bell says it's investigating a cyber incident in which some enterprise client data may have been stolen. A spokesperson confirmed an "agentic" threat actor was able to access some of the company's systems, including one used for ordering and supplying telecommunication networks.
title: Bell says it's investigating cyberattack that led to potential theft of business customer data

author: Meghan Grant
description: A Calgary man who threatened to kill Prime Minister Mark Carney and one of his children in videos posted to social media pleaded guilty to a number of offences on Friday.
title: Calgary man who threatened to kill Prime Minister Mark Carney in TikTok, YouTube videos pleads guilty

description: U.S. tech companies that build artificial intelligence data centers in other countries will face "a tremendous tax," President Donald Trump said on Friday.
title: Trump threatens 'tremendous tax' on U.S. tech companies that build AI data centres in other countries

description: California's state bar is investigating former White House press secretary Katie Zacharia after a complaint she represented herself as a lawyer without having ever passed the bar exam.

description: The beloved hippo Fiona died Thursday at the Cincinnati Zoo after eating a knit hat that was accidentally tossed into her enclosure earlier this month. Here's a look back at the life of the famous hippo.
title: IN PHOTOS | Fiona: A look back at the famous hippo's life

description: A new study commissioned by the group behind Eastern Canada's proposed high-speed rail line lays out the project's potential to benefit people's lives, their communities and the region's economy if it's done right.
title: Alto-backed study predicts major economic gains along proposed high-speed rail corridor

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: The Dancing With The Stars Season 35 finale airs Tuesday, Nov. 24. Five stars remain: Olympic figure skater Amber Glenn, comedian and podcaster Connor Wood, Paralympic gold medallist Ezra Frech, reality star Maura Higgins and actor Tatyana Ali.
title: Dancing with the Stars Season 35 finale: What you can expect

description: Criminal duo Lucia and Jason's blitz through Vice City in Grand Theft Auto VI helped Take-Two Interactive, the publisher of the blockbuster game that is now a global cultural phenomenon, rake in nearly $4 billion US in first-day sales.
title: GTA VI hauls in $3.79 billion US in massive 1st day of sales

author: Jessica Wong
description: Original Baywatch star Erika Eleniak is opening up about work and money challenges — including nearly being evicted from her home — amid a recent career upswing since joining OnlyFans, the online subscriber platform known for its popularity with adult audiences.
title: Baywatch's Erika Eleniak says OnlyFans has her 'calling the shots' after money woes

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: The new reveal of Canada's top 25 most wanted fugitives might look like something out of the Harry Potter movies. But while the moving images of the men and women used by the Bolo Program aren't magical, they also aren't real — they're AI.
title: Images of Canada's most wanted are AI-generated. How do we know they're accurate?

author: Peter Zimonjic
description: The federal and Ontario governments are meeting with auto executives from Stellantis on Friday in a last-ditch effort to save thousands of high-paying auto manufacturing jobs at the company's recently closed Brampton plant.

description: The Supreme Court of Canada will issue its long-awaited ruling on Quebec's secularism law, known as Bill 21, on Nov. 27.
title: Supreme Court ruling for Quebec's secularism law coming on Nov. 27

author: Lauren Pelley
description: Influenza appeared relatively early this fall, with a strain that often impacts younger adults. Medical experts aren't yet sure if this wave of infections will peter out before the holidays or if Canada will see a second surge of flu later in the winter.

description: Whether or not the Bay du Nord offshore oil project moves ahead is now up to the companies behind it, as the project has secured its last milestone approval from government.

author: Jessica Wong
description: The latest Grand Theft Auto instalment continues in the franchise tradition of riling folks up with its mature content, inevitably boosting the game's illicit allure for kids. Experts share tips on navigating its release with young gamers.

author: Nahlah Ayed
description: Legal experts say the International Court of Justice's first ever finding of genocide committed by a state may also help shape how that case and others like it are decided in the future. Victims, human rights activists and legal observers had hoped that the case, filed against Myanmar in 2019, would open a new pathway for delivering justice on the international stage.

description: Several parents with children enrolled in Marshall Law Driving Academy say they feel blindsided by its sudden closure last week after each paying the company hundreds of dollars.

description: A family ran their business, LeoMay Fusion, out of a food truck for about a year in rural Nova Scotia until RCMP officers showed up in mid-October and they learned a previous lender was repossessing the vehicle.

description: Russia launched missiles and drones across Kyiv overnight that killed three people, injured nine others and damaged bridges and transport infrastructure, local authorities said Friday.

author: Michelle Gagnon, Jacaudrey Charbonneau, Judith Plamondon
description: A young Canadian woman travelled to Turkey after graduating from medical school. In her last days there, she fell ill and died within hours. Authorities there blame food poisoning, but a joint investigation by Enquête and the fifth estate revealed 12 similar deaths and a different poison at work.

description: Two Canadian high-tech firms have taken a step toward challenging Elon Musk's Starlink with plans for a homegrown military satellite communications system. Dominion Dynamics has signed a $2.2-million deal with Telesat to develop Arctic-ready technology, part of a broader effort to strengthen Canadian sovereignty and develop an uncrewed combat aircraft.

author: Chris Brown
description: Canadian investment firms, led by Toronto-based Brookfield, have become central targets in Spain's Nov. 29 election fight over housing affordability. Long-term Madrid tenants living in former public housing allege Brookfield plans to let their rent-controlled leases expire and sell their apartments at unaffordable market prices.
